image_description: A close-up portrait of a bison's head and shoulders. The image features the characteristic shaggy dark brown fur, a prominent shoulder hump, short curved horns with a yellowish base, and a visible dark eye. The background is a soft-focus green field.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large broad head with short curved horns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is clearly large and broad relative to the frame. Two short, curved horns are distinctly visible emerging from the top of the head.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is cropped at the neck/shoulder level; the chin and throat area where the beard would be located are outside the frame or heavily obscured by the angle and fur density.
One eye is clearly visible, appearing dark and realistic with a specular highlight.
No distinct, large ears are protruding; the ear region is covered by the thick shaggy fur, consistent with the 'hidden' description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Massive body with exceptionally tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the body shows significant mass and height at the shoulder (withers), consistent with a bison's build.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The texture is distinctly shaggy and dark brown. The silhouette clearly shows the characteristic high shoulder hump.
The hindquarters are not visible in this close-up crop.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short horns compared to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The horns appear short and stout relative to the massive size of the head and shoulder hump.
Legs and hooves are completely out of frame.
The tail is not visible in this head-and-shoulders crop.

artifact_observations.location: Right horn base and surrounding fur
artifact_observations.reasoning: The transition between the horn material and the fur on the right side appears slightly 'mushy' or fused. The texture of the horn lacks the distinct keratin ridges seen in real photography, looking somewhat smooth and plastic-like.
The tip of the left horn fades into the background with a slight glow/halo effect rather than a sharp optical depth-of-field blur, suggesting minor generation artifacting.
